notes: HeyGen mirrors @ai-sdk/heygen 3.0.10: HEYGEN_API_KEY / x-api-key authentication, custom base URL/headers/transport and ai-sdk-heygen/3.0.10 user-agent; video/videoModel aliases and open model IDs; heygen-video-1 text-to-video, first-frame image-to-video and grouped image/video/audio reference conditioning. Typed HeyGenVideoModelOptions and HeyGenVideoAsset validate HTTPS URL/asset/base64 inputs, mode conflicts, 9 image/3 video/3 audio/12 total reference limits, prompt/duration/seed bounds, all documented frame sizes and size-class/aspect-ratio constraints before I/O. AsyncVideoModel start/status operations retain videoId/mode/resolution, support durable JSON persistence and shared polling/idempotent retries, and return refreshed signed MP4 URLs without downloading. Reported output duration/dimensions/seed/inference timing and failure codes are preserved without inventing token or credit usage. Native credentials resolve at factory creation. Unary generation, remote cancellation, webhooks, avatar/voice/translation APIs and JavaScript model/workflow serialization are absent from this provider surface; unsupported fps/audio/count settings warn.
